content.text: {"rows":[{"source_id":"id09611","target":"Д’Артаньян, Портос и Арамис радостно вскрикнули."},{"source_id":"id09612","target":"Атос отступил на шаг и провёл рукой по лбу:"},{"source_id":"id09613","target":"— Рок! — прошептал он."}],"review":[{"source_id":"id09611","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Faithful: the three named characters, the exclamation of joy (poussèrent une exclamation de joie → радостно вскрикнули), and the past tense are all preserved. The name д’Артаньян matches the established form."},{"source_id":"id09612","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Faithful: Athos stepped back one pace and passed his hand over his forehead; the closing colon is kept, so the sentence still leads into the next line of dialogue. Idiomatic Russian."},{"source_id":"id09613","verdict":"PASS","reason":"«Fatalité!» is rendered as «Рок!», a natural literary equivalent for an exclamation of fate. The prior ledger shows a change to «Фатальность!» and then a reversal to «Рок!». The final reading is correct: «Фатальность» is an unidiomatic calque here. The murmured delivery (murmura-t-il → прошептал он) and the dialogue punctuation are preserved."}]}
